newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Tuesday, as cautious sentiment over higher prices started to surface in the market after Monday's price gains, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per gram lower to 0.6 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February was up 0.3 yen at 144.0 yen.

"After the benchmark February broke above 145 yen on Monday, profit-taking pressured the market," an analyst at a commodity broker said. "Fresh news will be needed for the market to rise further," he said.
